description.narrative: The Rehabilitation Center Surakarta archive collection consists of information about the history of the first rehabilitation centers for people with disabilities in Asia and the Pacific. The archive contains realization of integrated rehabilitation programs involved by women as the initiator which in the 1958-1980 was hardly to be recorded in Indonesia. The records consist of textual (475 files), photographic (2157 sheets). Most of them are still undigitized. They carry a considerable risk of damage, considering that Indonesia has a tropical climate so that archival media in the form of paper will be very easily damaged due to its high acidity.
